'''Char-Nok''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Weequay/Legends|Weequay]] member of the [[Cult of the Screaming Blade]], serving its leader [[Paladius]].<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Char-Nok appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' during the Sith Inquisitor class mission on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]].
